_what_this_is: Cumulative USD ceiling on BILLED model calls, enforced in shared/llm.py. Over it, complete() raises LLMBudgetExceeded and calls nothing. LLM_FAKE calls cost nothing and are never counted or refused.
_why_10: Every role runs on Claude Opus 5.5 ($4 in / $20 out per MTok). A healthy 48-hour Modal shadow watch is projected at about $0.95, and about $2 if every call uses the full 1,024-token thinking headroom (arithmetic in shared/llm.py, 'the spend ceiling'). The runaway this bounds is precall_tick or poller on */5, 576 runs in 48 h, which is $32 (one proposal per run) to $161 (20 replies re-classified every run). $10 is roughly 5x a busy watch at worst-case thinking and stops either runaway at $10. It does NOT cover the first shadow poll's backlog: runbooks/deployment.md, 'What the first shadow poll costs'.
_before_going_live: This is a rehearsal number. Raise it once real reply volume is the point, and reset the counter: python3 -c "from shared import llm; llm.reset_spend()"
_note: budget_usd <= 0 does NOT mean unlimited. It falls back to the $10.00 default with a warning, so a typo cannot remove the ceiling.
